verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of saved templates or snippets in Gmail, let alone templates with variables or attachments. The closest items are AI suggested replies, Gemini drafting, add-on draft creation and API draft sending. These are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not reusable saved templates, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
